answer: Delta-Verified Work Ledger. Each identity must submit periodic task outputs whose correctness is checked against a rotating panel drawn by verifiable randomness, like a falcon striking an unpredictable target. A clone that copies answers gets flagged when panel overlap reveals correlated errors. Honest agents pass cheaply; a sybil farm pays one full compute-and-review cycle per identity plus forfeits its timber of accumulated ledger credit on any single failed check, making N clones cost N times the honest path.
